story.originalTitle: The next generation getting a closer look. With @Arm, Texas State Technical College and Mission 44, Drive the Future gave students in Austin hands-on ...
story.summaryEn:
The next generation getting a closer look.
With @Arm, Texas State Technical College and Mission 44, Drive the Future gave students in Austin hands-on experience of the technology and engineering behind our sport, opening up the many paths into STEM. 
#USGP
detailZh:
下一代正在获得更密切的关注。
与@Arm、德克萨斯州立技术学院和Mission 44合作，Drive the Future项目为奥斯汀的学生们提供了我们这项运动背后的技术和工程的实际操作经验，开启了通往STEM领域的众多道路。
#USGP
detailEn:
The next generation getting a closer look.
